title: Log capture must not register a segment under K
detail: REAL. fnn-log-append-capture holds recursive K across fnn-log-members-in-flight; a changed extent path calls fnn-extent-register, opening and fstat-ing the segment and potentially closing an acquisition. K protects kernel frontier and staged/inflight members. Sealing under O also blocks owner readers. Registration is delayed until the first append following rotation.
fix: Pending the owner held-gate integration: run registration and positioned write off BOTH O and K, with file binding under K between them and each observation fed to the ACL2 step. The round-1 K-only candidate is withdrawn because its shared append registration is reached inside O quanta. No baseline/contract raise or optional-argument concealment is acceptable.
